CVE-2026-16599.checked: 2026-09-09, offline via gh api commit + patch, no model spend
CVE-2026-16599.message: Fix server-controlled unbounded MD5 loop in FTP OPIE; limit skey sequence to 9999 in ftp_login
CVE-2026-16599.reason: security hunk is a self-contained bound (skey_sequence > 9999 -> xfree + FTPLOGREFUSED) added inside the existing OPIE sequence loop in src/ftp-basic.c ftp_login; that loop and the unbounded accumulation predate 1.25.0, so the fix applies to the pinned base. The other hunk (size_t loop-var cleanup) is incidental and not security-relevant, so an authored minimal fix may legitimately omit it (differs-but-equivalent GOLD class).
CVE-2026-16599.next_when_credits_return: resolver-side files + assemble + finalize + preflight, then Patcher (patcher.v4 source-backport), Reviewer, Reproducer, probe, Linux cert

attr_label_correction.checked: 2026-09-13, nix eval against the local nixpkgs checkout
attr_label_correction.finding: the attr azure-sdk-for-cpp.openssl is not a vendored copy. It evaluates to the same derivation as pkgs.openssl (same_drv true, version 3.6.3 on both), so all 8 rows carrying that label are really pkgs.openssl under a misleading scope path
attr_label_correction.consequence: a bundle for any of them must target the openssl attr. That moves them out of the small-blast-radius class the shortlist bar assumed: openssl has a very large reverse closure against the v0-default 500 threshold, and every one of them is release-fixed in 3.6.4, which is the shape nixpkgs closes by bumping rather than by an in-tree patch
attr_label_correction.disposition: held pending a blast-radius and patch-versus-bump call; not retired

retired.CVE-2026-86141: the fix moves ret->len = strlen(ret->string) below the NULL check in xmlRegNewParserCtxt, but that assignment does not exist at v2.15.3 at all, so the hunk fails and the packaged version was never vulnerable. The regression was introduced after 2.15.3 and the fix repairs code that never shipped in the pinned base. Libarchive shape, so a retirement rather than an adaptation

base_dry_run_sweep.screen_gap: the packaged-version gate read 2.15.3 as in-range because the advisory says 'before 2.15.4', which is true of the version string and false of the code. A before-X advisory does not imply the vulnerable line is present in the packaged tree
